name: xtractor
title_zh: 只读不写的 X 数据取件器，推文到关注列表全给
tagline_zh: 刷推、翻回复、搜话题、拉时间线、取书签、查列表、看主页、数粉丝——只读不写，不碰你的账号安全，一次取全。
tagline_en: Pull tweets, replies, search, timelines, bookmarks, lists, profiles, followers—read-only, no write access, no.
desc_en: Use for read-only Twitter/X retrieval: tweets, replies, articles, search, timelines, bookmarks, lists, profiles, followers, and following.
why_zh: 把 X 的只读接口收拢成一套，不碰任何写操作，取数干净利落。
why_en: One clean read-only layer over X's API—no write ops, just reliable retrieval.
limit_zh: 仅覆盖 X/Twitter 的只读检索，不含发帖、点赞、私信等写操作；需自行准备 X API 密钥。
limit_en: Read-only X/Twitter retrieval only; no posting/liking/DMs. Requires your own X API key. No media parsing inside tweets.
title_en: Read-only X/Twitter data fetcher: tweets to follower lists
